effects_provenance.raw: Alien Cookies - THCA BULK Flower - Greenhouse 1 Pound Alien Cookies - Smooth, Earthy, Calm-Inducing Hybrid Alien Cookies is an indica-dominant hybrid that balances serene body relaxation with a clear, contemplative headspace; dense, forest-green buds are frosted with amber trichomes and copper hairs, presenting a refined, hand-trimmed appearance. The nose opens with warm, earthy sweetness and subtle diesel undertones, while the palate follows with rounded vanilla and toasted nut notes for a smooth, lingering finish—crafted to feel natural, polished, and quietly memorable. Terpene Profile The aroma and effects of Alien Cookies are shaped by a complementary blend of terpenes: Myrcene : Offers a mellow, earthy aroma and contributes to a soothing, settled physical sensation. Caryophyllene : Adds spicy, peppery depth and brings a warming, grounded character to the smoke. Limonene : Lends a bright citrus lift on exhale that balances the strain’s deeper herbal tones. Effects Alien Cookies unfolds gently: an initial calming clarity softens into a tranquil body ease that keeps the mind pleasantly present rather than sedated. It’s ideal for winding down with intention—encouraging relaxed focus, warm comfort, and a quietly content mood without overwhelming heaviness. Flower Gold Canna

effects_provenance.raw: Pink Certz THCA Flower Supreme / 28g Strain Profile Pink Certz THCA Flower is a hybrid bred by Compound Genetics , crossing The Menthol with Grape Gasoline . The pedigree is real: a Pink Certz cut from Sense SF won the 2022 Transbay Challenge in San Francisco. Buds run frost-heavy with deep purple and pink expressions wrapped in dense trichome coverage. Effects Pink Certz delivers the kind of well-rounded hybrid lift that pairs equally well with conversation, creative work, or a long walk. The cerebral edge stays clear-headed without anxious tension; the body settles into a relaxed-but-not-sedated baseline. A reliable daytime-into-evening choice for users who want hybrid balance without giving up focus. Flavor & Aroma On the nose, Pink Certz is unmistakable: cool menthol up front, ripe grape candy in the middle, and a clean fuel finish from its Grape Gasoline parent. Smoke is smooth and mentholated with that Compound Genetics dessert-and-gas signature. The terpene profile leans loud and complex — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Pink Certz harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Pink Certz THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis (PDF) for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Pink Certz THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. THCA: 23.105% Delta-9 THC: 0.1903% Candy Grape hybrid Menthol THCA Flower Lost In Translation

effects_provenance.raw: Venom Runtz THCA Flower Preferred / 28g Venom Runtz THCA Flower combines tropical citrus, tart berries, and a sharp pineapple aroma with a spicy, pungent edge. Commonly described as an indica-leaning Venom OG × Runtz hybrid, it brings a brighter fruit profile alongside heavier reported body effects. Sweetness and sourness share the spotlight, giving Venom Runtz a distinctive appeal for fans of fruity flower with an assertive finish. Effects Product descriptions characterize Venom Runtz as beginning with a calming mental lift before developing into deeper body relaxation. A tingling physical sensation may accompany that shift, with heavier, sleepy effects becoming more noticeable as the experience progresses. These reported qualities suit an evening of music, movies, or simply settling down. Some users may find it particularly sedating; the strength and progression vary by batch and individual response. Flavor & Aroma Venom Runtz takes a tangy approach to the familiar Runtz sweetness, highlighting sour berries and tropical citrus. Pineapple-like notes add a bright, juicy dimension to the aroma, while spice and pungency give it a sharper edge as the flower is broken apart. The resulting profile moves between sweet fruit and tart tropical character, with a bold aromatic finish. effects_provenance.raw: Caked Up Candy · Greenhouse THCa Flower 14g Caked Up Candy THCa (Runtz × Caked Up Cherries) is an indica-leaning hybrid grown in the greenhouse with organic inputs. Dense, frosty buds carry the sweet candy character of Runtz with a creamy cherry edge. The nose is packed with cherry candy, sweet berries, and vanilla.
